title: Stoneskin Totem
lines: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.

title: Revenge
lines: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 109 to 133 damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

title: Lacerate
lines: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 75 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

title: Primal Bite
lines: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 77 and generating a high amount of threat.

title: Holy Shield
lines: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

title: Swift Judgement
lines: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

title: Templar's Bulwark
lines: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

title: Seal of Fury
lines:
Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 35 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 154 to 167 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.

title: Barkskin
lines: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

title: Frenzied Regeneration
lines: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

title: Shield Slam
lines: Slam the target with your shield, causing 640 to 670 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

title: Shield Block
lines: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

title: Enrage
lines: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

title: Defensive Stance
lines: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 30%.

title: Shield Wall
lines: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

title: Dire Bear Form
lines:
Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 180, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 1240. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

title: Maul
lines: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.
